id./param/scenario/cs/y_010_cs_046.pack|cs_: "We've been waiting, worm who hindered us.

"I am Hoopthorne. Granted Rhapthorne's
  power, I altered the eighth
  Adventure Log!

"I am Orgodelotl. King of all things,
  binder of heaven and earth,
  I serve Orgodemir, granter of power.

"You restored the seventh Log I rewrote
  and came even this far...
  Unforgivable.

"Come. I will carve my name
  into your corpse forever.

"You'll regret defying our god and
  restoring the Logs' order
  in the depths of hell!!

"I'll sear into your soul an eternal fear
  that doesn't vanish even in death!!
